langs.description: Languages used in the comment content (ISO 639-1)

root.description: Strong reference to the original post that started the thread

parent.description: Strong reference to the immediate parent (post or comment) being replied to

reply.description: References for maintaining thread structure. Root always points to the original post, parent points to the immediate parent (post or comment).

facets.description: Annotations for rich text (mentions, links, formatting, block structure)

errors.name: InvalidReply
errors.description: The reply reference is invalid, malformed, or refers to non-existent content

errors.name: ContentTooLong
errors.description: Comment content exceeds maximum length constraints

errors.name: ContentEmpty
errors.description: Comment content is empty or contains only whitespace

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: User is not authorized to create comments on this content

errors.name: InvalidFacets
errors.description: Rich text facets are malformed, exceed limits, or reference byte ranges outside the content

errors.name: InvalidImageFacet
errors.description: An #image facet breaks a placement rule: its index does not name an image of an images embed, it shares its facet with another feature, it places an index already placed, its range is empty, or its range lies inside a #code or #codeBlock range

errors.name: InvalidEmbed
errors.description: The embed is not a social.coves.embed.images, social.coves.embed.imagesWithAttachment with a quoted post, or social.coves.embed.post that satisfies its lexicon and the embed write rules; the message describes the failure

errors.name: TooManyImages
errors.description: The embed carries more than 8 images

cid.description: CID of the created comment record

main.description: Create a comment on a post or another comment. Comments support nested threading, rich text, embeds, and self-labeling.
